I've uploaded a code repository in the directory `/src/matio`. Consider the following issue description:

<issue_description>
Heap-based buffer overflow in Mat_VarPrint (src/matio/src/mat.c). While printing sparse matrix variables the function can read past the end of sparse index/data arrays (memory allocated by ReadSparse in mat5.c) due to insufficient bounds checking of the loop index, leading to out-of-bounds reads. This can cause memory corruption, crashes, or potential information disclosure when processing crafted or malformed MAT files.
